derivedFrom.acquisitionBoundary: The exact normalized parent is hash-pinned but not checked in. Its raw Binance archive inventory, .CHECKSUM files, and the post-2025 microsecond-to-millisecond normalization log were not retained.

normalization.aggregation: UTC floor(time / 900000) buckets; first open, maximum high, minimum low, last close, summed volume
normalization.completeness: retain only buckets containing exactly 15 contiguous one-minute rows spanning 840000 milliseconds

reproducibility.scope: derivation-verifiable from the exact normalized parent; not independently source-reproducible from the raw Binance archives
reproducibility.note: The script verifies the exact normalized parent SHA-256 and row count before deriving this immutable snapshot. Binance publishes archive .CHECKSUM sidecars, uses microsecond timestamps for Spot archive data from 2025 onward, and may later correct historical files.
